# Charts discover-apps should never propose again.
# Matches a chart's last path segment or a full oci:// chart URL.
# * and ? are globs matched against both: `*bitnami*` drops every bitnami chart,
# `oci://registry-1.docker.io/*` a whole registry. Without a wildcard the whole
# string has to match, so `redis` does not cover `redis-operator`.
#
# Add an entry here whenever you close a discover/* PR, otherwise the next run
# proposes the same chart.

# Not a helm chart
oci://ghcr.io/fluxcd/flux-manifests

*truecharts*
*ocharted*
